known.via: English Wikipedia "Hautes-Côtes de Beaune" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A Burgundy sub-region on top of and behind the Côte de Beaune escarpment, in valleys and slopes. Its one appellation covers red and rosé from Pinot Noir and white from Chardonnay. It has no Premier Cru vineyards.
